descriptionChirho: The proper noun Manasseh (מְנַשֶּׁה), referring to the firstborn son of Joseph, the Israelite tribe descended from him, the territory allotted to that tribe, or later individuals bearing the same name (e.g., King Manasseh of Judah).
The gentilicic adjective derived from Manasseh, used as a substantive to denote a member or descendant of the tribe of Manasseh (הַמְנַשִּׁי, 'the Manassite').
